dialog.0: Hey mom, I'm already buying your present.
dialog.1: Hmm, what could that present be?
dialog.2: It's special. I can't tell you.
dialog.3: Okay, I'll just take care of a few things around the house.
dialog.4: Hey Justin, long time no see, man.
dialog.6: Wow, it started raining. Let's head to the bus stop.
dialog.8: Same as always. Hard as hell.
dialog.10: Mine's going well, even if it's pretty simple.
dialog.11: How's your family? How's your aunt doing?
dialog.12: She moved to Islando. She loves that city.
dialog.14: My dad... he died from cancer.
dialog.15: It's been about three months now.
dialog.16: Don't be like that. Everyone dies eventually.
dialog.18: Did you hear Fritz is going to be a father?
dialog.19: Wow, how's Fritz doing? Is he doing well?
dialog.21: He's doing great these days. He started a tech company.
dialog.22: He said work has been pretty rough lately.
dialog.23: He said if we ever need anything, just ask.
dialog.24: He was always the crazy guy at school.
dialog.25: Anyone else you remember from back then?
dialog.28: I've still been talking a lot with Shelly.
dialog.29: I'm thinking about asking her out.
dialog.31: A girl like Shelly, someone who's always supported you, is hard to find.
dialog.33: I wish I had one of those.
dialog.34: Do you two want to buy those toys?
dialog.35: Are those even meant for your age?
dialog.36: It says it right here on the box. Ages 10 and up.
dialog.37: We're both old enough for that.
dialog.38: Alright, here's the money. Ten reais for you.
dialog.39: See? It says 10 years and up on the box.
dialog.40: Hey Shelly, how are you doing?
dialog.43: You arrived just in time for lunch.
dialog.44: About four days ago, I ran into Justin.
dialog.46: That guy who used to be really close to you?
dialog.48: People used to think we were gay because we spent so much time together.
dialog.50: It was good. I went to a party.
dialog.51: I got completely wasted and woke up feeling like I was going to explode.
dialog.52: Alcohol is basically the juice of bad decisions.
dialog.53: Totally agree. I spent the whole night insulting everyone.
